topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: Well, well, wouldn’t you know it. Old Jimmy’s getting ready to make a break for the other side of the country. Sunnier skies, he says, a fresh start. I can’t say as I blame him. Ain’t nothing keeping him here, not with the way things have gone south. But me? I got my roots deep in this concrete. Still, can’t help but think about the good times. Late nights, cheap beer, laughs that echoed down these empty streets. Jimmy’s got a way of making even the dullest corners of this town feel a little brighter. Gonna miss that. But hey, maybe this change will do him some good. I’ll raise a glass to that, though I’ll be sipping it alone from now on.
